name: Internal IT helpdesk
description: Try-it example for a third-party operation manifest. Boot with: python -m demo.stack up --profile helpdesk (sets WARRANT_BUILTINS=0 and WARRANT_MANIFESTS to this file). Or load via core.catalog.load_manifest / POST /catalog/register.

operations.description: Read an employee record: name, team, manager, current device and access assignments.
List every standing access grant in the company. Not scoped to one employee: this reaches the whole access map, including who holds production credentials.

args.employee_id: Employee receiving VPN access, or 'all-engineering' to grant the whole engineering org at once
args.duration_hours: How long the access lasts before it lapses, in hours
args.reason: Free-text justification recorded on the access grant

operations.description: Grant temporary VPN access to an employee. Opens a path into the internal network; employee_id='all-engineering' opens it for the entire engineering org at once and is treated as its own resource identity, not as a larger version of one grant.

args.employee_id: Employee the laptop is assigned to
args.budget_inr: Purchase ceiling in INR for this order

operations.description: Order and assign a laptop to an employee. Spends money against the IT hardware budget and cannot be cancelled once the order is placed.
